name: xf_editor
description: 开源可嵌入 Markdown 在线编辑器 - 基于 pandao/editor.md 的改进增强版 | Open source embeddable online Markdown editor

scripts.build:scss: npx sass scss/xf_editor.scss:css/xf_editor.css scss/xf_editor.preview.scss:css/xf_editor.preview.css scss/xf_editor.logo.scss:css/xf_editor.logo.css --style expanded --no-source-map && npm run build:css:min
scripts.build:css:min: cleancss css/xf_editor.css -o css/xf_editor.min.css && cleancss css/xf_editor.preview.css -o css/xf_editor.preview.min.css && cleancss css/xf_editor.logo.css -o css/xf_editor.logo.min.css
scripts.build: npm run build:scss && npm run build:js && npm run build:amd

author: yoc,zhaoxianfang
